758:t_1:664.en:
$$シエロ$$
「The one thing I regret is that I never got to see you as a bride.」

758:t_1:665.en:
$$メール$$
「Then no worries! The wedding is still to come!」

758:t_1:667.en:
$$メール$$
「$$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$, $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$, $c! Let's invite lots of guests from the parallel worlds, too!」

758:t_1:668.en:
$$メール$$
「A bride of the hyperdimensional world! I'm so happy!」

758:t_1:670.en:
$$シエロ$$
「You forgot your smile, $$ランド$$!」

758:t_1:671.en:
$$ランド$$
「Fine, if that's how it is, I'm going all in! I'll make up my mind, too!!」

758:t_1:673.en:
$$ランド$$
「Now that it's decided, let's do it! First I'll work my tail off to save up for the wedding!」

758:t_1:674.en:
$$ランド$$
「And then some great beer! No matter what becomes of the world, that won't change!」

758:t_1:675.en:
$$ランド$$
(That's how it is, $$ガンレオン$$. I'm counting on you from here on, too, partner.)

758:t_1:679.en:
$$パーラ$$
「Let's do this! We're the stars of the new world!」

758:t_1:680.en:
$$キッド$$
「Stars? You mean this junk shop, $$フリーデン$$?」

758:t_1:681.en:
$$パーラ$$
「The fighting's over now. From here on, let's hit it hard with honest business.」

758:t_1:682.en:
$$シンゴ$$
「$$パーラ$$'s right. We've gotten out of the $$バルチャー$$ business, after all.」

758:t_1:684.en:
$$ウィッツ$$
「If it were $$サラ$$, sure, but you...」

758:t_1:685.en:
$$エニル$$
「Don't say that. $$サラ$$ is going to stick with $$ジャミル$$ and go back to her work for the new government.」

758:t_1:686.en:
$$サラ$$
「Take care, everyone. I'm rooting for you in your new jobs.」

758:t_1:687.en:
$$ロアビィ$$
「You too. If anything happens, get in touch with us.」

758:t_1:688.en:
$$ジャミル$$
「Right... I'll count on you when that time comes.」

758:t_1:689.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Everyone's going their own way, huh.」

758:t_1:691.en:
$$ガロード$$
「But no matter what happens, I'll be with you, $$ティファ$$.」

758:t_1:693.en:
$$テクス$$
「The coffee's ready, just in time. Let's drink a toast to our new start.」

758:t_1:694.en:
$$ジャミル$$
「Then, may great fortune await each of us and the future of the world...!」

758:t_1:695.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Let's do our best, everyone!」

758:t_1:696.en:
$$ガロード$$
(And someday... I'll cross the parallel worlds to go see everyone...! Together with $$ティファ$$!)

758:t_1:700.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「...Then, $$キエル$$... Please look after the $$ムーンレィス$$.」

758:t_1:701.en:
$$キエル$$
「I don't know how much I'll be able to do, but... I will do everything I can to fulfill the duty you have entrusted to me.」

758:t_1:702.en:
$$キエル$$
「And I will bring about the $$ムーンレィス$$' long-cherished wish of returning to Earth by peaceful means.」

758:t_1:703.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Thank you, $$キエル$$. You are the Queen who will create a new era.」

758:t_1:704.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Captain $$ハリー$$, I leave the new Moon Queen to you.」

758:t_1:705.en:
$$ハリー$$
「I will, even at the cost of my life.」

758:t_1:706.en:
$$メシェー$$
「So you're going to be the Moon Queen, $$キエル$$...」

758:t_1:708.en:
$$メシェー$$
「But what really surprises me is that heir, $$グエン$$. After everything he did, he turns around and shrewdly becomes the lord of $$イングレッサ$$.」

758:t_1:710.en:
$$メシェー$$
「Um... $$ソシエ$$... I know it's hard, but...」

758:t_1:714.en:
$$ソシエ$$
「It's all right, $$ディアナ$$. $$ロラン$$ is the one who chose to go with you.」

758:t_1:716.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「But, $$ソシエ$$... Before long, $$ロラン$$ will be returning to you.」

758:t_1:718.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「I asked $$ロラン$$ to spend the time with me until I go to sleep.」

758:t_1:719.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「When that is over, $$ロラン$$ will go back to you.」

758:t_1:723.en:
$$ソシエ$$
「But I'll be waiting, always. So...」

758:t_1:726.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Do well, $$ロラン・セアック$$.」

758:t_1:727.en:
$$ロラン$$
(I'll be going, Miss. But... the place I'll come home to is by your side...)

758:t_1:728.en:
$$ロラン$$
(And someday... when the peoples of Earth and the Moon become one, let's go see everyone, too...)

758:t_1:732.en:
$$ベベル$$
「...Long ago, when the sun in the sky was dying, people were forced to choose between boarding a ship that crosses the stars or changing into $$クジライカ$$.」

758:t_1:735.en:
$$ベベル$$
「While the two humanities kept fighting, even after abandoning their homeland, this planet's civilization was perishing...」

758:t_1:736.en:
$$ベベル$$
「But thanks to the people who believed in hope, this planet and its seas were revived...」

758:t_1:737.en:
$$ベベル$$
「And so we on the waves, and the $$クジライカ$$ at the bottom of the sea, were both able to survive.」

758:t_1:738.en:
$$メルティ$$
「Hey, $$ベベル$$... What class is this?」

758:t_1:739.en:
$$ベベル$$
「Mr. $$オルダム$$ calls it archaeology.」

758:t_1:740.en:
$$ベベル$$
「By learning where we came from, we can think about where we're going... He says it's a very important field of study for the future.」

758:t_1:741.en:
$$サーヤ$$
「I don't really get it, but somehow, learning about the past is fun.」

758:t_1:742.en:
$$ベベル$$
「The mysteries should keep getting solved from now on. $$ガルガンティア$$ has a brave explorer now, after all.」

758:t_1:743.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「$$レド$$... Looks like you're being called.」

758:t_1:744.en:
$$レド$$
「Are you talking about me, $$ベベル$$?」

758:t_1:745.en:
$$ベベル$$
「Yeah. Thanks to $$レド$$ salvaging old records from the ruins, we're figuring out all sorts of things.」

758:t_1:746.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Good work today too, $$レド$$. Did you find anything?」

758:t_1:747.en:
$$レド$$
「I found a recording medium. In this condition, $$ピニオン$$ should be able to analyze it.」

758:t_1:748.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Still, I don't get you. If you used that tin can, you could do all kinds of things a lot more easily.」

758:t_1:749.en:
$$レド$$
「I can't keep relying on $$チェインバー#pilot$$ forever. I want to become able to live by my own strength.」

758:t_1:750.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit respects Ensign $$レド$$'s judgment. Also, this unit has its own duties.」

758:t_1:751.en:
$$レド$$
「You've gotten used to the unloading work, too.」

758:t_1:752.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Nothing is impossible for this unit.」
